inForce.statedAs: This consolidation is current to September 15, 2026. [Last amended July 1, 2026 by B.C. Reg. 97/2026]
inForce.basis: BC Laws presents this as the current consolidation of an unrepealed enactment; no repeal line appears in the document. The site's separate 'Amendments Not in Force' list was not reachable by the routes tried (see researchNotes); the Point in Time index for B.C. Reg. 190/84 lists no version dated after July 1, 2026.
